about_the_game:
Invisible Room is a unique audio-based puzzle game where players must rely entirely on sound cues to explore, solve mysteries, and uncover the hidden truth. Unlike traditional games that use visuals as the primary medium, Invisible Room challenges players to sharpen their auditory perception and logical reasoning.

To progress through the game, you will need to carefully listen to environmental sounds, character dialogues, and subtle audio clues to map out the invisible world around you. Additionally, the game incorporates printed materials that serve as essential tools for deciphering puzzles, creating a truly immersive and interactive experience.

Key Features

  • 🎧 A Fully Audio-Based Experience – No visuals, only sound. Immerse yourself in a world that exists purely through audio.

  • 🕵️ Deep and Engaging Puzzle Mechanics – Use logic and deduction to interpret the sounds and solve mysteries.

  • 📜 Real-World Printed Materials – Some puzzles require the use of physical documents, adding a tactile layer to the game play.

  • 🎭 A Mysterious and Atmospheric Narrative – Piece together the story through sounds, voices, and ambient clues.

  • 🔊 High-Quality Audio Design – Every sound is crafted to provide crucial information, making keen listening a necessity.

Can you navigate the unseen and uncover the secrets hidden within the Invisible Room?
